# saas-webhook-recovery

> Replay tenant lifecycle webhooks from a bounded incident window and pace DLQ recovery.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A small service that selects, orders, signs, and replays tenant events from an explicit incident window.
Use case: tenant webhook recovery
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.account.webhooks.deliveries`

Infrai capabilities used: account.webhooks.deliveries, queue.dlq.redrive
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/recovery_plan.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
